description: Bandula Sujith Senarathna v. Y.I.M. Silva, Divisional Secretary, Mirigama Bandula Sujith Senarathna v. Y.I.M. Silva, Divisional Secretary, Mirigama View More before Bandula Sujith Senarathna v. Y.I.M. Silva, Divisional Secretary, Mirigama Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
parties: Bandula Sujith Senarathna v. Y.I.M. Silva, Divisional Secretary, Mirigama Bandula Sujith Senarathna v. Y.I.M. Silva, Divisional Secretary, Mirigama View More
judgement_by: Bandula Sujith Senarathna v. Y.I.M. Silva, Divisional Secretary, Mirigama Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
keywords: Writ of Certiorari – Quit notice – State land – Bona fide purchaser – Approximately 21 acres adjoining Kandy Road, Mirigama – Transfer by predecessor-in-title shortly before quit notice – Disputed title – Government survey – Failure of predecessor to produce deeds and plans to surveyor – Surveyor concluding land was State land – Earlier Survey Department plan – Land allegedly acquired under Land Acquisition Act – Non-disclosure of surveyor’s report – Questionable conduct of purchaser and predecessor-in-title – Insufficient basis to interfere – Notice refused. S. Thurairaja PC J. agreed.
legistation: Land Acquisition Act is expressly referred to in relation to the State’s position that the land had been acquired. The judgment concerns a quit notice concerning alleged State land, but the short order does not expressly identify the particular section of the State-land recovery legislation under which the notice was issued.
